Queen's Recruit#000.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.dst: Mel y Lanu, estarán en la E{~}.

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: Habitación W{~}... Ahora en marcha. Me quedan muchas habitaciones por asignar...

Queen's Recruit#003.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#003.dst: Tasim quiere ponerse al día contigo en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#004.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#004.dst: ¡{u}! ¡Eh! Qué suerte haberte pillado por aquí.
Queen's Recruit#004.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#005.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: Cuánto tiempo, ¿eh? ¡Tenemos que ponernos al día! Seguro que has vivido un montón de aventuras, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#006.src: But before that... I've just got to find...
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: Pero antes de eso... solo tengo que encontrar a...
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: Huh? What am I oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: ¿Eh? Qué estoy... ah, sí. Estoy buscando a Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: Me escribió pidiéndome ir con él a una... misión de reconocimiento. Pero no lo encuentro.
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: Sí que tardé en llegar aquí... así que quizá ya se haya ido a otro sitio. Aegis me dijo que al final cancelaron la misión, así que...
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: Pero si no está aquí, será mejor que deje de buscarlo por las calles, ¿no? Le dejaré un mensaje en los barracones.
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#011.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#011.dst: ¡Podemos ir a la taberna a ponernos al día! Dioses, cómo echaba de menos el Rusty Recruit... el tabernero dice que sirve igual que los demás, ¡pero qué va! Nadie sirve como él.
Queen's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#012.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: Perdón, con permiso- ¡voy pasando! ¡Paso! ¡Ah, vosotros dos! Justo a quienes buscaba.
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#013.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: Perdón, con permiso ¡voy pasando! ¡Que paso! ¡Ah, vosotros dos! Justo a quienes buscaba.
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#015.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: Bueno, quizá no exactamente. ¡Tengo una lista de gente a la que localizar y vosotros estáis en ella! Tasim y {u}, ¿verdad?
Queen's Recruit#015.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#016.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: Traigo un mensaje importante de {p}. ¡Del propio rey, sí, sí!
Queen's Recruit#016.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#017.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#017.dst: ¿En serio? Creo que no lo he visto desde... ¿para qué nos puede querer?
Queen's Recruit#017.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#018.src: I'm not privy to the details I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned visitors to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: ¡Me temo que no conozco los detalles! Convoca al castillo a varios visitantes veteranos como vosotros, para una especie de reunión.
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#019.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#019.dst: En fin, aún tengo que localizar a más gente, ¡así que os doy las cartas y sigo mi camino! ¡Mucha suerte con lo que sea!
Queen's Recruit#019.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#021.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks for later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: Hm. Es raro, ¿verdad? Habrá que dejar las copas para otro día... quizá sea lo mejor. Igual consigo encontrarlo antes de...
Queen's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#022.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: Ah, eh- ve tú delante. Yo tengo que pasar antes por los barracones. ¿Nos vemos en {p}?
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: Nos vemos en {p}. Antes tengo que resolver unas cosas en los barracones.
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#024.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: Asiste a la reunión con el rey en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#025.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#025.dst: ...ah, ahí estás. ¿No habías salido antes que yo?
Queen's Recruit#025.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#026.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: Aquí no conozco a casi nadie, así que de momento me quedo contigo.
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#027.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: ...y se viene todo abajo, ¿vale? Así que aparto al zombi de un golpe, agarro al crío y salto hacia
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#028.src: Wait, wait wait wait you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: Espera, espera espera espera, ¿me estás diciendo que había un crío? ¿¡Y aun así hiciste estallar las bombas!?
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#029.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I
Queen's Recruit#029.dst: ¡Sí! Ya lo había dicho, ¿no? Esa fue justo la razón por la que
Queen's Recruit#029.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#030.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: Ejem. Pausa la historia un momento, Linton. Tenemos compañía.
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#031.src: Well if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: ¡Anda, pero si es {u}! Qué bien ver otra cara conocida por aquí.
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#033.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#034.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: ¿Así que vosotros también recibisteis la convocatoria? El rey ha reunido a mucha gente. Interesante.
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#035.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#035.dst: Sí, la recibimos. Y parecía que en esa lista buscaban a mucha más gente.
Queen's Recruit#035.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#036.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: Oh, disculpa, no te había visto. Eres amigo de {u}, ¿me equivoco?
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#037.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#037.dst: ¡Lo soy! Llegamos a Wynn en la misma caravana. Soy Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#039.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: ¡Así que tú eres de quien Aledar hablaba siempre! ¿No estabas en Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#040.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: Creo que nos conocimos en una misión para recuperar los barracones de {p} de un comandante traidor. Desde entonces nos hemos cruzado varias veces.
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#042.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: ¡Aun así, me alegro de conocerte por fin! ¡Hemos oído un montón de historias! ¿Incluida alguna sobre no contestar cartas...?
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#043.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#043.dst: Ah... ya. Eso, eh... ya lo arreglamos.
Queen's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#044.src: But speaking of have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: Pero hablando de eso, ¿alguno lo ha visto hace poco?
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#045.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: Me temo que no. Creo que no nos cruzamos desde... ¿el asedio de {p}? Tuvo que ser eso.
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#046.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: ¡Yo lo vi hace un mes en {p}! Le pregunté en qué andaba y si podía ayudar, y me dio largas. Raro, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: Mmn. No, eso es muy suyo. Creo que se hartó de tus payasadas la última vez.
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#048.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: ¿¡Qué!? Soy competente. Venga, Mel, dile que soy competente.
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#049.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by
Queen's Recruit#049.dst: Linton, si acabas de contarnos cómo hundiste un templo entero al
Queen's Recruit#049.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#050.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#050.dst: ¡Vale! Vale, vale vale, ¡hablemos de literalmente otra cosa! Tasim, ¿no? ¿Qué... eh...
Queen's Recruit#050.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#051.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: ...bueno, tu... no, no, dame un momento, tú estabas... y... eh... ah, ya...
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#054.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#056.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: Ha sido un placer conocerte, Tasim. Espero trabajar contigo en esta misión.
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#057.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#057.dst: ...igualmente. Siempre es agradable conocer a amigos de Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#058.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#058.dst: ¡Vaya, mírate! Hace bastante que no hablábamos. Ya estás muy por encima de limpiar cloacas, ¿eh?
Queen's Recruit#058.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#059.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: He oído hablar de tus logros. Buen trabajo, buen trabajo.
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#060.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#060.dst: Y... hm. ¿No eres tú el que se largó a Gavel sin decir ni mu? No esperaba verte entre los elegidos para esto.
Queen's Recruit#060.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#061.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: Yo... tampoco me lo esperaba. Ni siquiera sabía que el rey aún se acordaba de mí, la verdad.
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#062.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: Mmn. Bueno, sea por lo que sea, ya estás aquí. Supongo que da igual el camino que tomaras. Nos hace falta toda la gente posible, o eso dice Kymer.
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: ¡Vaya, vaya! ¡Si no me engañan los ojos! ¡{u} y Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#064.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: ¡He de decir que no esperaba que os localizaran! Con esa... larga temporada vuestra en Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#065.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: Lo mismo digo de usted, capitán. ¿Ya no le servía a {p} cuando acabó la guerra?
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#066.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: Ah... nada de eso. ¿Sabéis? ¡A mí me enviaron allí más bien como enviado de {p}! Si el rey necesita resolver un asunto diplomático, soy el primero al que recurre.
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#067.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've entered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: Y... por eso mismo estoy aquí ahora. Me hicieron volver de forma muy brusca hace unas semanas. Parece que estamos en una situación delicada con nuestra... provincia vecina.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#068.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: ¡Pero! No diré más antes de que llegue el rey. Él os hablará del problema que, ojalá, podamos resolver.
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#069.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#070.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: Si alineamos el flujo de maná con Agua y lo desviamos un poco, quizá... ah, Reynauld, pásame las notas sobre... maldita sea, ¿qué era? Ah, sí, ¡el periodo de recuperación! Esas.
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#071.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: ...Ya las tiene a su izquierda, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: ¡Anda, es verdad! Eso parece... oh, pero esta es solo la primera mitad... ¿dónde habré dejado el resto?
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#073.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: Ay... Si me dejara ordenárselo todo, quizá no
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#074.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have
Queen's Recruit#074.dst: ¿¡Y arruinar mi sistema de ordenación predefinido!? No, Reynauld, funciona perfectamente tal cual, ¡muchas gracias! Bien, ¿dónde puede haber
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#075.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Vosotros dos! Bien, bien, estáis aquí... ¡temía que Reynauld fuera el único por aquí con los recuerdos recuperados!
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#076.dst: ¿Qué, no lo probó con nadie más después de que nos fuéramos?
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Test it on no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: Probarlo con... ¡claro que no! ¿Después de lo que vi? No, no, no merecía el riesgo. ¡Ningún sujeto nuevo hasta estar seguro de que es perfecto!
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: ¡En su lugar lo he estado usando conmigo mismo! Y dejad que os cuente los avances que he logrado... hay mucho que aprender.
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Pah! "Safety" a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: ¡Bah! "Seguridad": un término vacío creado para frenar el progreso. ¿Efectos secundarios? ¡Desde luego! Pero ha merecido la pena.
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#081.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: Bien, debo volver a mis papeles... tengo unas ecuaciones que pulir antes de que llegue el rey...
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#082.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: Hm. No esperaba encontrarte aquí, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#083.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#083.dst: Bueno... el destino tenía otros planes, supongo. ¿Y tú? ¿Te quedaste en {p}?
Queen's Recruit#083.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#084.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#084.dst: Más o menos. Me moví por algún destino que otro, pero siempre acababa volviendo.
Queen's Recruit#084.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#085.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: ...hace tiempo que no hablamos. ¿Estás... bien? ¿Cómo llevas los recuerdos?
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#087.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#087.dst: Todo lo bien que cabría esperar, supongo. Los primeros meses fueron duros. Al final me acostumbré.
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#088.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: ¿Y tú? Tampoco esperaba verte en una misión así.
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#089.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: Igual que tú. Ayudó que Caid y yo pudiéramos hablarlo. Nos vemos de vez en cuando y lo comentamos. Él habla de su hermana, de que quiere encontrarla algún día.
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#090.dst: Eso... está bien. Me alegro por ti.
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#091.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: Hm. Nada te impide pasarte tú también. Puede que hasta te ayude.
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#092.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#092.dst: Me lo... pensaré. Me alegro de verte, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#092.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#093.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#094.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#094.dst: ...bien. Pase, {u}. El rey llegará en breve.
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#096.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#097.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: Ah... ya estamos todos. Os agradezco que hayáis venido con tan poco aviso. Hacía tiempo que no veía a muchos de vosotros.
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#098.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: ...Iré al grano. Nos hallamos en una posición muy delicada en lo que toca a nuestras relaciones con la provincia vecina, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.

Queen's Recruit#102.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#102.dst: Suena muy sospechoso. ¿A qué viene ese interés repentino? ¿Y por qué ahora?

Queen's Recruit#103.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once they have chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#103.dst: Dependemos mucho del flujo de reclutas que nos envían, pero no tenemos forma de contactar con su provincia. Solo ellos pueden acudir a nosotros, y solo cuando así lo deciden.
Queen's Recruit#103.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#104.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#104.dst: ...hace unas semanas recibimos a una visitante encapuchada por las afueras. Dijo ser de Fruma, una de sus Soberanas.
Queen's Recruit#104.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: Se nos hizo una especie de invitación. De todos los reclutas que hemos recibido, debíamos elegir a los mejores y enviarlos a Fruma a una especie de celebración.
Queen's Recruit#105.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#106.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#106.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#107.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: ¡Al menos, los que se podía localizar! Quizá hubiera otros mejores, pero todos conocemos las costumbres errantes de los de vuestra clase, y dar con ellos puede resultar
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#108.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: Uf, no vamos a seguirles el juego sin más, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#110.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: ¿Qué? Piden algo raro y claramente sospechoso, ¿por qué habríamos de aceptarlo sin más?
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#111.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: Me temo que no tenemos elección. Como he dicho, los reclutas que recibimos son decisivos para la supervivencia de nuestra provincia. Si rechazáramos esta invitación...
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#112.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: ...quién dice que no dejarían de mandarlos, ¿eh? Mal asunto.
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#113.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#113.dst: ¡Y además, pensad en la oportunidad que supone! ¡Una visión auténtica y ofrecida de lo que hay tras esos muros! ¡Seríamos necios si no aceptáramos, pese a la amenaza implícita!
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#114.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: En efecto. Lamento tener que pediros esto... pero no hay otra opción. Debéis aceptar la invitación.
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#115.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: ...¿incluso los que tenemos malas experiencias con esa provincia?
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#116.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: Lo siento... pero debes. Tengo las manos atadas.
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#117.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: Entiendo que se espera que reunamos toda la información posible sobre Fruma mientras estemos allí, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#118.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: ¡Ese es el plan, en efecto! Ya explicaré más cuando lleguemos, pero creo que tenemos un tiempo limitado, ¿correcto?
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#119.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: ¡Ese es el plan! Ya explicaré más cuando estemos allí, pero creo que el tiempo es limitado, ¿correcto?
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#120.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: Así es, doctor. Me han dicho que un representante os recibirá en las puertas reales de Fruma, situadas en la costa occidental.
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#121.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: He enviado un mensajero a {p} para avisar a los capitanes locales de adónde deben llevaros.
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#122.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: {p}... Conozco a un capitán allí. {u}, ¿te vienes conmigo?
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#123.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: Por fin... un vistazo al funcionamiento interno de la provincia... ¿cuánto llevo buscando estas respuestas?
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#124.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: Tantas teorías... ¿cuántas se confirmarán? ¿Cuántas serán erróneas? ¡Estoy impaciente por saberlo!
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#125.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: Ay... sabía que esto llegaría. ¿Por qué si no habrían convocado al doctor? Pero esperaba equivocarme.
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#126.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: Situación complicada, ¿eh? Mucho secretismo por parte de los frumanos...
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#127.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: Pero lo resolveremos. Al fin y al cabo, aquí todos son muy capaces.
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#128.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: Hm... ¡vaya situación en la que nos encontramos! La diplomacia es mi especialidad, claro, pero mi experiencia no me ha preparado para... esto.
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#129.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: Fruma sabe lo que quiere, y sabe que es lo bastante fuerte como para poder retirarse cuando le convenga.
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#130.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: ¿Otra misión de alto secreto ya? ¿Y ni siquiera puedo traer mis explosivos?
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#131.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: ¡Al menos es interesante! Mucho mejor que el último encargo...
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#132.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lot's o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: Es una misión importante, ¿eh? Han llamado a mucha gente fuerte.
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#133.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: ¡La verdad, me pone un poco nerviosa!
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: Fruma... no puedo decir que pensara mucho en ella. Es un misterio, sí, pero sin respuestas a mano.
Queen's Recruit#134.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#135.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: Bueno, hasta ahora, supongo. Tendré que preparar una lista de detalles en los que fijarme...
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#136.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: Y una vez más, debo enviaros al peligro... de otra clase esta vez, pero peligro al fin y al cabo.
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#137.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: Recuerdo cada rostro que pasa por mi castillo. Rara vez vuelvo a ver alguno.
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#138.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: Pero esta vez... confío en que volveremos a vernos. Ve, joven héroe. Tu misión te espera.
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#139.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: ...de vuelta a Fruma. Acabo de volver a Wynn, y ahora...
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#140.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: Pero tenía que pasar tarde o temprano. Y quiero respuestas. Así que... vamos allá.
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#141.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: Iré al Seaskipper de {p}, por si quieres acompañarme.
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#142.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: Viaja a la Puerta de Fruma en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] o reúnete con Tasim en {p}.

Queen's Recruit#143.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#144.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: Es todo un poco surrealista, ¿no? Acabo de volver a Wynn y ahora... ¡Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#145.src: Kind of make me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: Casi desearía que Aledar estuviera aquí también. ¡Los tres de aventura otra vez! Volviendo... a casa...
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: Supongo que tendremos que contárselo todo cuando volvamos. Seguro que le da pena habérselo perdido.
Queen's Recruit#146.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#147.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#147.dst: ¡Eh, vosotros! ¿No serán esos mis dos clientes favoritos?
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#148.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#148.dst: ¡Eso se lo dice a todos, capitán! ¡No crea que no me doy cuenta!
Queen's Recruit#148.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#149.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#149.dst: Ejejeje, bueno, es verdad, ¿no? ¡Tengo muchos favoritos! Ah, en fin, venís a hacer un viaje, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#150.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#150.dst: ¡Sí! Ya... ¿ya conoce los detalles? Debería haber algo sobre un destino nuevo.
Queen's Recruit#150.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#151.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#151.dst: Sí. Eso sí. ¡Antes pasó zumbando un mensajero escuchimizado de {p}! ¡Apenas pude decirle nada antes de que saliera pitando! Un tipo curioso.
Queen's Recruit#151.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#152.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#152.dst: ... No es una parte del mar que me guste visitar, pero supongo que esta vez puedo hacer una excepción.
Queen's Recruit#152.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#153.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#153.dst: Hm... Puedo pagarle más por el viaje, si quiere.
Queen's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#154.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#154.dst: ¡Ja! No, no, no hace falta. ¡Para mis dos clientes favoritos es gratis, ejeje!
Queen's Recruit#154.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#155.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop on abour 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#155.dst: ...y, claro, de todas formas lo paga el tesoro real de {p}. ¡Venga, subid a bordo antes de que cambie de idea y me vaya sin vosotros!
Queen's Recruit#155.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#157.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#157.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#158.dst: Es todo un poco surrealista, ¿no? Acabo de volver a Wynn y ahora... ¡Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#159.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#171.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: ...así que Fruma, ¿eh? Os preguntaría qué asuntos tenéis allí, pero... imagino que es alto secreto.
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#172.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: Nos han... invitado a la provincia. Al parecer es por una especie de celebración, pero...
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#173.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: Mmn. Ya, conociendo los rumores... no es un sitio que invite a la gente así como así, ¿verdad?
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#176.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: Decidme, ¿qué os ronda la cabeza? A los dos. Por mi experiencia, decir las cosas en voz alta ayuda a manejarlas.
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#177.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: Fruma se esforzó tanto en borrarnos la memoria y quitarnos de en medio... y ahora nos reclama.
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#178.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: No sé por qué lo hacen, pero me temo que hay algo más detrás.
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#179.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: No tengo más idea que vosotros, pero me parece que la sospecha está justificada.
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: Pero que no te consuma, ¿vale? Algo de sospecha es sano, pero si lo tiñe todo, hace tanto daño como la ingenuidad. Mantén la mente abierta.
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#181.dst: ...es posible. Ojalá tenga razón y todo esté bien, y seamos nosotros los que le damos demasiadas vueltas...
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: Pero no puedo bajar la guardia. Todo en esta situación grita que algo no encaja, y... no sé qué es.
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#183.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: No hay nada malo en esperar lo mejor. A veces lo único que puedes hacer es mantener el ánimo.
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: Aquí en el mar tenemos un dicho... ve a buscar la tormenta y ella te encontrará a ti. No esperes lo peor, o hallará el modo de cumplirse.
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: ...¿a casa? A casa. Supongo. Estará bien tener más recuerdos de allí que solo... ya sabes. Maldiciones y demás.
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#186.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#186.dst: Linton y Kymer, en la W{~}.

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#187.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: Hm. Yo tampoco tengo mucho hogar al que volver. Me lo quitaron aquellos en quienes confiaba, ¡ejeje!
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#188.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#188.dst: ... Pero me hice mi propio hogar, aquí en el mar. ¡Creo que, aunque pudiera volver ahora, no lo haría!
Queen's Recruit#188.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#189.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: Si no te gusta lo que encuentres... no te sientas obligado a aceptarlo, ¿me oyes?
Queen's Recruit#189.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#190.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#191.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and salin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#191.dst: Ah, ¿no es para lo que estoy aquí? ¡Dar sabios consejos y llevar gente por el mar!
Queen's Recruit#191.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#192.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: ¡Mirad el horizonte! Muelles opulentos y relucientes... parece que hemos llegado.
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#193.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#193.dst: No sé a qué os enfrentaréis ahí dentro... pero suerte de todas formas, ¿eh?
Queen's Recruit#193.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#194.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#194.dst: La vamos a necesitar. Gracias por traernos, capitán.
Queen's Recruit#194.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#196.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#196.dst: Es... impresionante. Construir algo así para una puerta que nadie usa...
Queen's Recruit#196.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#197.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#198.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#198.dst: Reúnete con el grupo en la puerta, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#199.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#199.dst: ¡Por fin! Los rezagados. Desde luego os lo habéis tomado con calma, ¿eh?
Queen's Recruit#199.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#201.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#201.dst: No es el momento, Kymer. Deja en paz al pobre hombre una hora, ¿eh? Tenemos cosas más importantes.
Queen's Recruit#201.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#202.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#202.dst: Sí, sí, está bien. ¡No hemos logrado sacarle una palabra a ninguno de estos soldados! ¿Tenemos siquiera la hora y el lugar correctos?
Queen's Recruit#202.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: Qué va, es que no lo has intentado lo suficiente. ¡Eh, lata de hojalata! Esto es Fruma, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#207.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#207.dst: Es una construcción realmente impresionante, ¿verdad? Todo esto para una provincia cerrada.
Queen's Recruit#207.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#208.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#208.dst: ¡Impresionante o no, tenemos trabajo! Alerta, todos. No sabemos qué esperar, así que cuidaos las espaldas.
Queen's Recruit#208.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#209.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: Vete a saber cuándo nos dejarán entrar de verdad...
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#212.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#212.dst: ¡Soldados de Wynn! ¡Su Majestad os da la bienvenida a la provincia como invitados de la Corona!
Queen's Recruit#212.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#213.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#213.dst: Seguidme y seréis escoltados hasta el palacio real. No la hagamos esperar... sois de gran importancia para ella.
Queen's Recruit#213.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#214.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.
Queen's Recruit#214.dst: Escucha la presentación. Ve a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para volver al palacio.

Queen's Recruit#215.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: Fruma es... mucho más grande de lo que veía en mis recuerdos...
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#216.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: Tiene sentido, supongo. Entonces no viajaría mucho. Pero... aun así.
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#218.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: Lo... era. No sé qué esperaba al entrar, pero... fue impresionante.
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, ¿sabes? Creo que tienes razón. Era impresionante, pero Gavel también tiene vistas impresionantes.
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#220.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#220.dst: Pero no nos distraigamos. La visita ha sido muy... controlada. No nos dejaron salir de los carruajes, y el Soberano no nos quitaba ojo.
Queen's Recruit#220.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#221.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: Me interesa lo que están decidiendo no enseñarnos...
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#224.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: Como Reina, es un honor facilitar vuestro regreso a nuestra maravillosa provincia. ¡Por mucho tiempo que hayáis estado fuera, siempre seréis hijos de Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: Vuestra lucha contra la plaga que hay tras nuestros muros nos ha interesado mucho. Sin duda habéis honrado a esta provincia.
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: Tendréis preguntas sobre el motivo de vuestra convocatoria. Todo se revelará... pero antes, permitidme presentaros a dos de mis maravillosos Soberanos.
Queen's Recruit#226.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#227.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am
Queen's Recruit#227.dst: Habéis oído mi nombre, pero dejad que me presente. Yo soy
Queen's Recruit#227.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#228.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: Majin de la Casa Thalas, el Lucero del Alba, Soberano de la bella {p}. ¡Un placer, queridos soldados, acompañar a la Reina en esta ceremonia!
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#230.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#230.dst: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Soberano de {p}. El valor de ese título habla por sí solo.
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#231.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#231.dst: Gracias, Soberanos. Estos dos, y los demás, son mi consejo para gobernar la provincia. A cada Soberano se le confía un distrito, y trabaja al servicio de su gente.
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#232.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: Hay más. Aunque ninguno ha podido asistir a este acto - están ocupados con distintas misiones.
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: Ah, aquí está. Tasim y {u}, estarán en la habitación W{~}... en el ala oeste.

Queen's Recruit#234.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: Porque soy rápido y sigiloso. Me voy ya, no quiero llamar la atención de los guardias. ¡Recordad, la W{~}!

Queen's Recruit#236.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: Hay más. Aunque ninguno ha podido asistir a este acto... están ocupados con distintas misiones.
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: ¡Basta de charla aburrida! ¡Es hora del banquete de bienvenida!
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: Nos gustaría compartir una muestra de lo que ofrece nuestra provincia. Pasad, por favor, al gran comedor, situado justo detrás de mí.
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#239.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#240.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: Pasen al comedor, la Reina comenzará su discurso enseguida.
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#241.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: ...¿¡ni siquiera eres capaz de seguir el orden de las operaciones con Su Majestad delante!? ¿Qué valor esperado tendrán los reclu
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: Vamos, vamos, Nasin, cálmate. No querríamos dar mala impresión a nuestro invitado, ¿verdad?
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#243.dst: Deja de interrumpir mi secuencia, hipóc
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#244.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#244.dst: Ah, tú. Deberías ir al comedor con el resto de tu grupo.
Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#245.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#245.dst: Sí, sí, en marcha. ¡No querrás hacer esperar a Su Majestad!
Queen's Recruit#245.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#246.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: Bien, ya lo he aplazado bastante. Antes de que se sirva el primer plato, revelaré el propósito de vuestra presencia aquí hoy.
Queen's Recruit#246.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#247.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#247.dst: ¡Para celebrar vuestra labor en la provincia de Wynn, organizaremos un torneo! Participaréis todos en una serie de duelos para coronar al mejor soldado de entre vosotros.
Queen's Recruit#247.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#248.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#248.dst: Todos habéis crecido en vuestro tiempo fuera de nuestros muros, ¿y qué mejor forma de demostrarlo?
Queen's Recruit#248.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#249.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: Por supuesto, todos los participantes serán compensados. Cada uno recibirá una generosa recompensa en dinero, sea cual sea su puesto en el torneo.
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#250.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: Sin embargo, a quien se alce con la corona de vencedor... le aguarda una recompensa mayor. Los detalles se revelarán al concluir el torneo.
Queen's Recruit#250.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#251.src: Ah, your majesty if I may... I am not much of a fighter my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#251.dst: Ah, Majestad, si me permitís... no soy muy luchador; mi especialidad es la investigación y el estudio de la magia.
Queen's Recruit#251.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#252.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#252.dst: ...muy bien. Se harán las adaptaciones oportunas. A cambio, más adelante podría pedirte otra cosa.
Queen's Recruit#252.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#253.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#253.dst: Agradezco vuestra gracia y comprensión, Majestad.
Queen's Recruit#253.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#254.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#254.dst: Sí... y bien. Cuando termine la comida, se os asignará a cada uno una habitación para el resto de vuestra estancia en mi palacio.
Queen's Recruit#254.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#255.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Parece que el primer plato está listo! Disfrutad, por favor, de la mejor cocina de nuestra provincia.
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#256.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: ...no puedo decir que me esperara eso, precisamente.
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#257.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: Vas a participar en el torneo, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#259.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#259.dst: Será mejor que vayamos a buscar nuestras habitaciones... los demás han ido al sur.
Queen's Recruit#259.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#260.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#260.dst: Pide tu habitación asignada al representante en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#262.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#262.dst: Sus habitaciones están al este y al oeste de aquí.
Queen's Recruit#262.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#263.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#263.dst: Sus habitaciones están al otro lado del castillo. Diríjanse hacia allí, por favor.
Queen's Recruit#263.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#268.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#268.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#269.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: Están tirando la casa por la ventana, ¿eh? Hacía mucho que no comía nada tan bueno.
Queen's Recruit#269.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#270.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#270.dst: Sí, quizá la mejor comida en mucho tiempo... Me ha dejado agotado. Qué ganas de un buen descanso.
Queen's Recruit#270.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#271.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W3... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#271.dst: Ah, aquí está. Tasim y {u}, estarán en la habitación W3... en el ala oeste.
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#272.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#272.dst: ¿Y nosotros? Yo soy Mel, y este es Linton.
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#275.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E2.
Queen's Recruit#275.dst: Mel y Lanu, estarán en la E2.
Queen's Recruit#275.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#276.src: Uh hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: Eh, oiga, ¡creo que se olvida de alguien! ¿Dónde me alojo yo?
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#279.src: Linton and Kymer are in W2.
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: Linton y Kymer, en la W2.
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#280.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: Ah... eh, con Kymer, ¿eh? Eso es... hm. Vale.
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#282.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#282.dst: Ve a tu habitación, la W-{~}, y échale un vistazo.

Queen's Recruit#283.src: Room W3... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: Habitación W3... Ahora, en marcha. Me quedan muchas habitaciones por asignar...
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#284.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#285.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#285.dst: Hm... ¿{u}? ¡Creo que te has equivocado de habitación!
Queen's Recruit#285.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#286.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#286.dst: Qué raro que tenga una habitación para mí solo... pero, eh, no me quejo.
Queen's Recruit#286.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#287.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#287.dst: Kymer. ¡Claro! Guay, guay guay guay... Puedo dormir con los... bíceps... sí. Eso está... bien. Está bien. Genial, incluso.
Queen's Recruit#287.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#289.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: Parece bastante acogedora, supongo... aunque cuesta relajarse, con... ya sabes. todo esto.
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#290.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: ...estar en Fruma es más fácil de lo que creía. Hay bastante distancia con... los, eh, recuerdos.
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#291.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So... what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited just for this?
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: Pero, bueno, ahora estamos a solas. Así que... ¿qué te parece de verdad el torneo? Es raro, ¿no? ¿Por qué invitarnos solo para esto?
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#292.dst: Yo tampoco. No sé qué esperaba al entrar en Fruma, pero no era... esto.
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: Creo que tendremos que participar, pero con los ojos abiertos. Quizá la recompensa secreta tenga respuestas..
Queen's Recruit#293.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: Hm... seguramente tengas razón, solo que no se me ocurre qué puede ser.
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#295.dst: Quizá haya algo detrás de esa recompensa secreta para el ganador... habrá que esperar y ver, supongo.
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, vale. Yo también estoy algo emocionado. Hace mucho que no tengo duelos amistosos, así que estará bien medir mis fuerzas.
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#297.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: Pero no olvides por qué estamos aquí. No bajes la guardia. Hay algo en esa recompensa que mencionó... me inquieta.
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#298.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: Parece justo la clase de cosa que disfrutaría Aledar. ¿Qué mejor forma de probar su valía que ganar este torneo?
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#299.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#299.dst: ¡Y podría usar todas sus pociones y trucos! Siempre me está hablando de las creaciones horribles que ha mezclado.
Queen's Recruit#299.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#317.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room that's W1, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: Ah, eh, nada del otro mundo. Solo una reunión secreta. En el cuarto de Jenprest... la W1, al principio del pasillo.
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#318.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#318.dst: Picard dice que hablemos de lo que tenemos hasta ahora. También dijo que no entremos todos a la vez, ¡así que esperad unos minutos!

Queen's Recruit#320.dst: Supongo... que tiene sentido. Pero ¿por qué has venido tú y no
Queen's Recruit#320.speaker: Tasim
