Queen's Recruit#321.dst: Porque soy rápido y sigiloso. Me voy ya, no quiero llamar la atención de los guardias. ¡Recordad, la W1!
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#322.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: ...qué energía tiene. Bueno, vamos a la reunión. Me pregunto qué habrán notado los demás.
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#323.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: Reúnete con los demás en la habitación W-{~}, en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#324.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: Ah, bien, ya están aquí. Pasad, pasad. Deprisa.
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#326.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word ?!
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: Los mismos. Y ahora, Picard, ¿te importa decirme qué demonios pensabas al requisar mi cuarto sin decir ni mu?!
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Ah, eheh, well I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: Ah, ejeh, bueno... supongo que, eh, se me pudo pasar... ¡no importa! ¡Vamos justos de tiempo!
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#328.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: Hemos llegado hasta aquí, pero hay que planear los siguientes pasos. Aunque primero... empecemos por la información que hemos reunido.
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#329.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#329.dst: ¡Bueno, a la corona desde luego le sobra el dinero! Lo que hemos visto rivaliza con la nobleza más rica con la que tuve el placer de trabajar en {p}.
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#330.src: And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
Queen's Recruit#330.dst: Y el estilo arquitectónico... es único. Nunca había visto nada igual. Supongo que tiene sentido, si la provincia lleva tanto tiempo cerrada...
Queen's Recruit#330.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#331.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: Eh, basta de detalles sin importancia... ¿a alguien más le da mala espina el torneo? Raro motivo para hacernos volver.
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#332.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: Yo pensaba lo mismo. Y están dispuestos a pagarnos a todos por participar, sea cual sea el resultado... no entiendo por qué.
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#333.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it
Queen's Recruit#333.dst: Hm, bueno, la verdad es que no me preocupa demasiado
Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#334.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#334.dst: Sí, por cierto, Picard, ¿qué ha sido eso en el comedor? ¿No va a llamar la atención retirándose del torneo?
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#335.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: ¡Oh! ¿¡De qué sirve meterme en semejante escenario de combate!? Seré mucho más útil fuera de esa estructura, libre para recorrer el palacio.
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#336.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: Y además, me han pedido un resumen de mis notas de investigación, así que tampoco me libro del todo, por no hablar de
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#337.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: ¡Vale, calmaos todos! Tiempo limitado, ¿recordáis? Nos hemos desviado. Son ricos, presumidos y por algún motivo nos quieren peleando. ¿Qué más?
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#338.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: ...como decía antes de que me interrumpieran groseramente- no creo que del torneo se saque mucho aún. Es una pieza del puzle que encajaremos más tarde.
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#339.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: ¿Tenemos algo sobre la Reina y sus Soberanos? Es una estructura de gobierno interesante, pero supongo que tener línea directa con la Reina tiene valor para los distritos.
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#340.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#340.dst: Bueno, está claro que están actuando. Seguro que nos ocultan algo, y no creo que ninguno se alegre de vernos tanto como dice.
Queen's Recruit#340.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#341.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent to Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: Sí, desde luego... nos enviaron a Wynn como exiliados, no como soldados honrados. ¿Por qué fingen lo contrario? Ellos nos han llamado de vuelta.
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#342.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#342.dst: ¡Ah! ¿Y si no saben que hemos roto ese hechizo de memoria? Por lo que ellos saben, seguimos creyendo sus mentiras.
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#343.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#344.src: So am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: ¿Soy el único al que le extraña la cantidad de guardias?
Queen's Recruit#344.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#345.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be placed under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#345.dst: Uno pensaría que a nueve desconocidos en el palacio real los vigilarían más de cerca.
Queen's Recruit#345.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#346.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: Ahora que lo dices... los únicos guardias que vi de camino a las habitaciones estaban en la salida del patio. No hay ninguno fuera de nuestras puertas.
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#347.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#347.dst: ...¿entonces no hacía falta todo el rollo del sigilo?
Queen's Recruit#347.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#349.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: Yo diría que quieren que nos sintamos seguros y de fiar. Saben que contaremos todo lo que veamos, así que ¿por qué no dejar buena impresión?
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#350.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: Un hechizo potente debería atravesar esta madera sin problema.

Queen's Recruit#351.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: Además, tienen a esos dos Soberanos vigilándonos. Bastante fuertes, ¿eh? Con eso basta para no buscar problemas.
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#352.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards by extension anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: Hablando de los Soberanos... y de los guardias, ya puestos... ¿alguien más sabe leer el maná? ¡Es como si aquí no se usara nada!
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#353.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: Iba a comentarlo. No he visto ni un solo mago. Lo más parecido son los soldados de mayor rango con armas mágicas.
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#354.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something wrong with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#354.dst: A mí no se me da tan bien leer el maná, pero... con los Soberanos pasa algo. Les rodea un aura increíblemente poderosa. Se siente... antinatural.
Queen's Recruit#354.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#355.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#355.dst: Sí, tienes razón. Ellos y la Reina son los únicos que he visto aquí con magia innata. Es más, los tres parecen muy ligados en cuanto a energía...
Queen's Recruit#355.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#356.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#356.dst: Por interesante que sea, al resto no nos deja mucho de lo que tirar. Doctor, usted nos ha reunido aquí. ¿Cuál es el plan?
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#357.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#357.dst: Sí, así es... bueno, parece que nuestra pista más prometedora son los Soberanos. Conviene centrarse en ellos- aunque no descuidéis la información general. Seguimos queriendo saber cuanto sea posible sobre Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#358.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#358.dst: Llevamos ya demasiado rato, dejémoslo por hoy. Descansad todos, mañana debemos rendir al máximo.
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#359.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#359.dst: Volvamos a reunirnos aquí mañana por la tarde. Buenas noches a todos.
Queen's Recruit#359.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#360.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Queen's Recruit#360.dst: Vuelve a la W-{~} y duerme.

Queen's Recruit#361.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#361.dst: Esos Soberanos... sí que me preocupan. Si los dirigentes de Fruma tienen tanto poder, entonces...
Queen's Recruit#361.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#362.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#362.dst: Hm. Quizá nuestro rey acierte al no ponerlos en su contra.
Queen's Recruit#362.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#363.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#363.dst: Ah, genial, ahora os quedáis todos aquí. ¡Fuera de mi habitación! No pegaré ojo hasta que os vayáis...
Queen's Recruit#363.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#364.src: ...damned Doctor should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: ...¡¡el maldito doctor podría haber usado su propio cuarto!!
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#365.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: ...ay. ¿Qué hago yo aquí? Debería haberme quedado en {p}.
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#366.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: Solo espero que nadie de aquí me conociera antes. No sé si lo soportaría.
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#367.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: Hm... una lástima no poder pelear en el torneo. Un premio en metálico vendría bien, con mis fondos de investigación menguando...
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#368.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#368.dst: Pero, ay, no soy luchador. Quizá el rey quiera financiar mis futuras investigaciones...
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: Uf, ojalá me vaya bien mañana en mi combate. Estoy algo nerviosa... ¡nunca me he batido en duelo!
Queen's Recruit#369.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#371.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#372.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: Esa magia... ¿por qué me resulta familiar? No sé precisar qué es, pero...
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#373.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#373.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#374.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: Buenas noches, {u}. Espero que duermas mejor que yo.
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#376.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#376.dst: ¡{u}! ¡Como sigas durmiendo, nos perderemos la primera ronda!
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#377.dst: ¡Ah, ya te has levantado! Buenos días.
Queen's Recruit#377.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#379.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: Bueno, te entiendo. Creo que no dormí más de una o dos horas. No dejaba de... Debí imaginar que aquí sería peor. Solo esperaba... en fin, es lo que hay.
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#380.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: En fin, menos mal que estás en pie. Un soldado ha venido a decirnos que vayamos a la arena del torneo.
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#381.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: Tú... no, solo... llamaron y metieron el aviso por debajo de la puerta.
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#382.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: ¿Entró alguien en nuestra habitación por la noche...?
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#383.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: Aun así. Tenemos que ir a la arena. Por lo visto está en la parte norte del palacio.
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: Encuentra el lugar del torneo en el lado norte del palacio, en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#386.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: Vaya, vaya. Parece que al fin veremos cuál de los dos es más fuerte, ¿eh, capitán?
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: ¿Oh, al fin? ¡No sabía que hubiera duda! Teniente, ¿de verdad crees que tienes alguna posibilidad contra mí?
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#388.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#388.dst: ¡Ah, déjate de poses, Kymer! Ahora serás muy elegante, pero recuerdo cuando eras un novato asustado por un pobre zombi viejo.
Queen's Recruit#388.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#389.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#389.dst: ¡Ja! Ah, qué buenos tiempos. Buenos tiempos. Algún día también te reconocerán, ya verás. ¡Puede que hasta superes mi rango!
Queen's Recruit#389.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#390.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#390.dst: Eh, eso dices siempre. Además, los rangos bajos me van bien. No llevaría bien toda esa "responsabilidad" que los peces gordos te echan encima.
Queen's Recruit#390.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#391.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#391.dst: ...dicho todo eso, ¡cuando nos toque vas a caer igual! He aprendido trucos nuevos desde la última vez, ¡así que no te confíes!
Queen's Recruit#391.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#392.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#393.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#393.dst: Si buscan la arena del torneo, sigan este pasillo y giren a la izquierda.
Queen's Recruit#393.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#394.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#394.dst: La arena del torneo está más adelante en el pasillo.
Queen's Recruit#394.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#395.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: Por desgracia, esta zona no es accesible en este momento.
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#396.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: Estos son los aposentos privados de Su Majestad.
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#397.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: Me temo que aún no puedo dejarle pasar. No hasta que
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: Sí, sí, mis notas de investigación, ya lo sé. Ya está resuelto. ¿Puedo ir ya a la biblioteca?
Queen's Recruit#398.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#399.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#399.dst: No me interrumpa. No puede entrar hasta que termine esta ronda del torneo. Órdenes de Su Majestad.
Queen's Recruit#399.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: Bah. ¡Está bien! Está bien, sí, esperaré. Válgame.
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#401.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't want to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: ¡Uno pensaría que tendría algo de libertad, pero no! ¿¡Qué más da que no quiera ver los combates si no hay otra cosa que hacer!?
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#402.dst: Ah, ve y quítate el combate de encima. Deja de dar largas.
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#404.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#404.dst: Baje por estas escaleras para llegar a la arena del torneo.
Queen's Recruit#404.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#405.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#405.dst: Los emparejamientos se anunciarán cuando estén todos presentes.
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#406.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#406.dst: Eh. Soberano... ¿Majin? Soberano Majin. Ya estamos todos.
Queen's Recruit#406.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#407.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#407.dst: ¡Vaya, ya era hora! Como invitados de la Corona, os convendría llegar puntuales a estas cosas, ¿hm? La tardanza no queda bien.
Queen's Recruit#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#408.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: Nuestras disculpas, Soberano. Parece que no se nos dio tiempo de venir antes... un simple error, estoy seguro.
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#409.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: Ah, la incompetencia de nuestros inferiores... ¡nunca deja de asombrar! Aun así, el deber de llegar a tiempo sigue siendo vuestro. Hacedlo mejor la próxima vez, ¿queréis?
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: Bien, soy un hombre muy ocupado, así que seré breve. Como ya explicó Su Majestad, ¡este torneo constará de varios duelos! No estáis obligados a ver cada combate.
Queen's Recruit#410.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#411.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: Se aplican las reglas habituales. Nada de matar, mutilar ni atacar a nadie fuera de la arena - aunque probad, ¡disfrutaría viéndoos fracasar!
Queen's Recruit#411.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#412.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is
Queen's Recruit#412.dst: Dicho esto, ¿alguna pregunta? Espero que no, tengo mucho a lo que volver en cuanto esto
Queen's Recruit#412.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Ah, I do I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: Ah, yo sí... no participo en el torneo. Me dijeron que hoy habría alguna alternativa.
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#414.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: Ah, sí... tú. ¿Qué dijiste que eras, un... investigador?
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: ¡Ajajaja! ¿Y a ti te eligieron como uno de los mejores de tu provincia? ¡No me hagas reír! ¡Ajajajaja!
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#416.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: Ah, pero mejor así, supongo. Nueve no cuadra bien en un torneo como este. ¡Mejor un investigador que un noveno luchador!
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: Sí, alguien vendrá a verte enseguida. Siéntate a un lado y hazte el remolón, o lo que sea que hagas- desde luego ya no eres mi problema.
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#423.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: ¡Excelente! El primer emparejamiento parece ser... {u} y Mel. Dad un paso al frente los dos.
Queen's Recruit#423.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: ¡Venga, deprisa, preparaos! ¡Elegid un pasillo cada uno, norte o sur, y a pelear de una vez!
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#427.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: En cuanto a los demás... ah, me da pereza. Mirad vosotros mismos los emparejamientos en el tablón.
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: Eh... pues vale. Supongo que elijo este.
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#429.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: Comienza tu combate contra Mel en la sala de espera sur.

Queen's Recruit#431.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: ¡Que tengamos una misión aquí no significa que vaya a contenerme!
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#432.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: ¿¡Empezamos!? ¡Vamos a enseñarles de qué estamos hechos!
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#433.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#433.dst: ¡Uf! ¡Vaya combate! ¡Se me ha acelerado la sangre!
Queen's Recruit#433.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#434.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#434.dst: ¿Qué te ha parecido mi truco? Bastante bueno, ¿eh? ¡Así no soy un blanco fácil en combate!
Queen's Recruit#434.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: Ah, tampoco esperaba ganar nada, la verdad. Pero ha estado bien intentarlo.
Queen's Recruit#435.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#436.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: ¡{u} ha vencido a Mel en la primera ronda y pasa a la siguiente!
Queen's Recruit#436.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#438.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: Se le permitirá permanecer en el palacio mientras dure el torneo. Se le pagará por su participación al final de su estancia.
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#439.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: Supongo que tiene sentido. Me pregunto cuándo será el combate de Lanu...
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#440.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: {u}, enhorabuena por la victoria. Se le avisará cuando sea su próximo combate. Mientras tanto, descanse si lo desea.
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: Sal de la sala de espera de la arena y busca a Picard en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#442.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: ¡Ha sido un buen combate! Pero ahora más te vale ganar en mi honor, ¿me oyes?
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#443.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: Anunciaremos su próximo combate más tarde. Mientras tanto, descanse o disfrute del palacio.
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#444.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: ¡Ah, {u}, he visto el combate! Gran técnica, mejor que la de muchos soldados que vi pasar por {p}.
Queen's Recruit#444.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#445.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: ¡Supongo que no me sorprende! Cuando anunciaron el torneo, se me ocurrió que podías ganar. Tú y otra persona, eso sí.
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#446.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#446.dst: Hm... quizá podría aceptar apuestas sobre quién ganará... ah, no, no, estoy demasiado ocupado. Concéntrate, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#446.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#447.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: ¿Hm? ¡Vaya por Dios, había olvidado que estabas aquí! Sí, iba a hacer algo...
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#448.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: ¡Oh! ¡La biblioteca! ¿Te lo puedes creer? ¡Ese maldito guardia por fin se ha ido! Es ridículo... ¿a quién le importa vigilar una biblioteca?
Queen's Recruit#448.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#449.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take the opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: Pero. Pero pero pero. El paso está libre y, aunque la ronda del torneo siga en curso, ¡quiero aprovechar mientras pueda!
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#450.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: ¿Te apuntas? Seguro que ahí dentro encuentras algo interesante. Qué clase de saber habrán ocultado los frumanos entre estos muros...
Queen's Recruit#450.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#451.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: Bueno, ¿vienes? ¡Vamos, rápido, antes de que vuelva el guardia!
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#452.dst: Sigue a Picard al interior de la biblioteca.

Queen's Recruit#453.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: Cielos, ¿por dónde empezar siquiera? Aquí hay tantísimo...
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#454.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: ¡Os presento al Céfiro Incesante, señor de {p}, el último de la estirpe de una de las grandes casas nobles de Fruma! ¡Su señoría, el Soberano Zhiraok Nasin!

Queen's Recruit#455.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: ...¡y que estemos rebuscando entre los Malditos y no entre nuestros ciudadanos es un riesgo incalculable!

Queen's Recruit#456.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#457.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#457.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#458.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: No calculo su ángulo en esta caza.
Queen's Recruit#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#459.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: ¡Ah, es como si hablara otra vez con ella! Qué nostalgia oír a un Nasin despistado esforzándose al máximo, pese a su incompet
Queen's Recruit#459.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#460.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: ¿PERDONA, INTEGRANDO IGNORANTE? ¿De verdad crees que es momento de- Rrgh... Para qué. Me molesto siquiera.
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#461.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#461.dst: ¡Pues eso, para qué! Es una pésima costumbre. Algo que corregir mientras tus mayores hacen lo importante, ¿hm?
Queen's Recruit#461.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#462.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: Hablando de eso, debo decir que todo esto me parece algo extraño. Fuerza no nos falta aquí, así que ¿para qué molestarse con los exiliados?
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#463.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: ...ay... El factor de riesgo es mucho mayor de lo que yo apostaría. Ella debe de saber más que nosotros, quizá luego nos den un sumatorio.
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#465.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#465.dst: Ah, ahí está. ¡Llega tarde con estilo, como siempre!
Queen's Recruit#465.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#466.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.
Queen's Recruit#466.dst: Hm. Más bien he llegado pronto.

Queen's Recruit#467.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#467.dst: Diría que tu momento es áureo- si vienes por ese sumatorio que mencioné y no por otra cosa.
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#468.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#468.dst: Lo primero. Pero antes, ¿habéis visto los combates? ¿Destaca alguno de los participantes?

Queen's Recruit#469.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#469.dst: ¿Destacar? Qué va. Hasta ahora no me ha impresionado nadie.
Queen's Recruit#469.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool
Queen's Recruit#470.dst: Cómo no. Yo he visto cosas prometedoras, pero necesito conocer la solución esperada para acotar el conjunto
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: ¡Ah, ah! Cálmate, Nasin, hablan tus superiores. Primero calcula cómo salir del último puesto.
Queen's Recruit#471.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#472.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: Más tarde, entonces. Tenemos problemas. Los participantes andan fisgoneando. Y el doctor está tomando notas minuciosas.

Queen's Recruit#473.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: ...parece que dejarle fuera del problema fue un error de cálculo, ¿eh?
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#474.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#474.dst: Por una vez, parece que estamos de acuerdo. Qué lástima, qué engorro... no me parece que merezca el esfuerzo.
Queen's Recruit#474.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#475.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: Lo merecerá. Pero ya he pasado demasiado tiempo aquí. Tendréis que esperar por las respuestas.

Queen's Recruit#476.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: Por supuesto. Me pregunto cuánto más irracionales podemos ser.
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#477.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#477.dst: Si queréis algo que vigilar, uno de los candidatos más prometedores tiene combate pronto. Id a verlo.

Queen's Recruit#478.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her, Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: Un placer, como siempre. ¡Bueno, ya la has oído, Nasin! ¡Vamos, vamos, a las gradas!
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#479.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#479.dst: ...así que ni siquiera los Soberanos saben lo que pasa. Fascinante. Muy fascinante.
Queen's Recruit#479.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#480.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: ¡Y había un tercero! ¿Quién era? ¿Otro Soberano...? Maldita sea, maldita sea, ¿cómo no me di cuenta?
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#481.src: Well, they appear to be onto us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: Parece que nos han descubierto. No importa. Habrá que ir con más cuidado.
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#482.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: Será mejor que vuelvas a la arena. Mientras tanto, yo seguiré buscando aquí... ¡tiene que haber algo útil!
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#484.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: ...¿hm? Ah, sí, está bien, contaré a los demás lo que hemos oído. Cuando termine aquí, por supuesto.
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#485.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: ¡La primera ronda del torneo ha concluido!
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#486.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: Los nombres que pasan a la siguiente ronda... ¡{u}! ¡Tasim! ¡Reynauld! ¡Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#487.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: {u}, su combate comenzará en breve. Su rival ya está en la sala de espera.
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#488.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: Comienza tu siguiente duelo en la arena, escaleras abajo.

Queen's Recruit#490.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: Diríjase a la arena bajando las escaleras, por favor.
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#491.src: Please go to the waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: Pase a la sala de espera y prepárese para el combate.
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#493.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#493.dst: Bueno, seguro que serás más reto que Linton, eso desde luego.
Queen's Recruit#493.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#494.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: Has avanzado mucho desde {p}, ¿verdad? ¡Pues yo también! Luchemos.
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#495.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#496.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: Ah... buen combate, {u}. Hasta usé mis flechas más potentes.
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#498.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: Lo sé, lo sé. Fuiste un rival digno, {u}. Y ahora vas a ganarlo todo, ¿verdad?
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#499.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#499.dst: {u}, enhorabuena por llegar a la final. Todos los demás rivales han caído, salvo usted y el otro finalista.
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#500.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: Hmpf. Eso se anunciará en breve. Diríjase al patio y espere nuevas instrucciones.
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#501.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: Vuelve al patio en [-{~}, {~}, {~}] y busca a los demás participantes.

Queen's Recruit#502.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: Lo hice bastante bien, supongo. De todos modos, me alegraré cuando esto acabe.
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#503.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#503.dst: Diríjase al patio y espere nuevas instrucciones.
Queen's Recruit#503.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#504.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: ¡{u}, has vuelto! ¿Y bien, cómo fue tu combate?
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#505.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#505.dst: ¿Tú? Supongo que tiene sentido. Sin ánimo de ofender, Reynauld, pero yo habría apostado por {u} de haber podido.
Queen's Recruit#505.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#506.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: Ja. ¡Para mí lo fue, desde luego! Sentía que apenas podía hacer mella en tu aguante.
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#507.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#507.dst: Sí, sí, toca felicitar y todo eso... tenemos problemas.
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#508.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could
Queen's Recruit#508.dst: Ya era bastante problema que lo llamaran aquí, para empezar... y pensar que podría
Queen's Recruit#508.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#509.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#509.dst: Ya basta de hablar del torneo. No quiero oír más. El doctor tiene razón.
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#510.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: Sí, bueno, no es tu honor el que está en juego... pero está bien, lo admito, este tercer Soberano es... inquietante.
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#511.src: Hm. Have we been able to find the information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#511.dst: Hm. ¿Hemos podido encontrar la información que necesitábamos?
Queen's Recruit#511.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#512.src: No! And that is precisely our problem we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: ¡No! Y ese es justo nuestro problema... se nos escapa algo, ¡y se nos acaba el tiempo! Un último combate, y se acabó.
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#513.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#513.dst: ...la verdad, me sorprende que estuvieras de mi parte en ese combate.
Queen's Recruit#513.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#514.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: Ah, bueno, ¡alguien tenía que bajarle los humos! Y ese alguien fuiste tú.
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#515.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: Oh, déjame en paz, teniente. ¿Él? Justo él, entre todos
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#516.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#516.dst: ¡Eh, estáis todos aquí! ¿Es... aquí donde querían que nos reuniéramos?
Queen's Recruit#516.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#517.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#518.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#518.dst: Sí. Parece que ya soy finalista. ¿Y quién es el otro?
Queen's Recruit#518.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#519.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#519.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Pues enhorabuena! Aunque supongo que pronto nos enfrentaremos.
Queen's Recruit#519.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#520.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what's next, before
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: Válgame... sí, el torneo ha ocurrido, enhorabuena a los finalistas, lo que sea... ¿dónde están Mel y Linton? Hay que hablar de lo que viene, antes de que
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#521.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: ...¿y qué, ahora no puedo echarme una siesta? ¡¡Si ni siquiera estaba peleando!! Mel, apóyame, ¡venga!
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#522.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#522.dst: ¡Tiene razón, esto no es justo! Nos dijeron que podíamos quedarnos en las habitaciones hasta el final del torneo, ¿¡a qué viene el cambio!?
Queen's Recruit#522.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#524.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: Todos los competidores que hayan perdido en el torneo serán escoltados fuera de Fruma con efecto inmediato.
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#525.src: what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#525.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#526.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: ¡SILENCIO! Son nuevas órdenes de Su Majestad.
Queen's Recruit#526.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#527.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: Solo {u} y Tasim tienen permiso para permanecer en el palacio. Cualquier desacato se considerará una amenaza oficial contra Fruma por parte de la provincia de Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#528.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: Obedezcan y nadie saldrá herido. Seguirán recibiendo la recompensa prometida por participar.
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#529.dst: ...esto es un ultraje. La falta de respeto
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#530.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#530.dst: Basta, Kymer. Lo hecho, hecho está. No tenemos opción.
Queen's Recruit#530.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#532.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: Vosotros dos. Cuidaos y estad alerta. Informaré al rey de esta noticia. Si no os sueltan sanos y salvos...
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#533.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#533.dst: ...{u}. Tasim. Ya tengo lo que vine a buscar, pero... no sé qué planean. Tendréis que arreglároslas solos.
Queen's Recruit#533.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#535.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: Finalistas restantes, se les espera en el comedor en breve. Acudan a su última comida antes de la final.
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#537.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: ¿Qué ha sido eso? ¿Qué acaba de pasar?
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#538.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#538.dst: Nos han cambiado las reglas, y ahora... uf, no tenemos opción... Hay que llegar hasta el final.
Queen's Recruit#538.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#539.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: Bueno... vamos. Asistamos a nuestra última cena aquí.
Queen's Recruit#539.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#540.dst: Asiste a la cena real en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#541.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#541.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#542.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: Nos dejarán salir. Tienen que hacerlo. Si no, sería un desastre diplomático.
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#544.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: Por si aún no lo sabíais, vuestros compañeros han sido devueltos a Wynn. Sanos y salvos.
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#545.dst: ...si me permitís la pregunta, Majestad, ¿no teníamos un acuerdo? Todos nos quedaríamos aquí hasta que el torneo acabase con la final.
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#546.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: ¿Oh? ¿Y te gustaría reunirte con ellos? Eso se puede arreglar... podríamos elegir un vencedor aquí y ahora, y terminar con todo este
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#547.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: ¿¡Cuál es tu problema, Thalas!? ¡Son invitados de Su Majestad! Qué irracional eres, queriendo restarlos sin su aprob
Queen's Recruit#547.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#549.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: Respondiendo a tu pregunta, las circunstancias han cambiado. No hay necesidad de que el resto de tu grupo siga aquí.
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#550.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: El resto del torneo seguirá su curso previsto.
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#552.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#553.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#553.dst: Otro bocado de la cocina de Fruma... la carne se importó de {p}, y las verduras vienen del jardín real.
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported from the {p}, and the vegetables came from our royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: Otro bocado de la cocina de Fruma... la carne se importó de {p}, y las verduras vienen de nuestro jardín real.
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: Ahora, al asunto. La final se celebrará mañana por la mañana. Pero antes, quiero hablar con cada uno de vosotros en privado.
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: Empecemos por... {u}. Ven al ala noreste cuando te venga bien.
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#558.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#558.dst: Habla con Su Majestad en el ala noreste del palacio, en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#561.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#561.dst: Bien. Supongo que toca felicitarte, finalista.
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#562.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#562.dst: Sientes curiosidad, ¿verdad? ¿Con qué propósito llamaría yo a unos soldados de vuelta a nuestra provincia?
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#563.src: Certainly not for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#563.dst: Desde luego no por un torneo de vanidad. Una celebración sin sentido.
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#564.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#564.dst: Oh, dejemos la fachada. Sé lo que habéis estado haciendo en secreto. No estoy ciega.
Queen's Recruit#564.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#565.src: You chose this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#565.dst: Elegisteis esta ocasión para buscar información sobre nuestra provincia. Lo poco que habéis averiguado lo consideramos un coste aceptable.
Queen's Recruit#565.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#566.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: En estas circunstancias, habría sacrificado mucho, mucho más.
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#567.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers - a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#567.dst: Los mejores de Wynn... categoría muy amplia. Había que reducir el número - una prueba de fuerza lo logró bien.
Queen's Recruit#567.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#568.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#568.dst: Y ahora... quedan dos candidatos. Has hecho bien en llegar hasta aquí. He seguido los duelos con atención, y desde luego no eres poca cosa.
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#569.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#569.dst: Aun así, de los dos... tú dejas una impresión menor que él. Eres uno entre cientos, miles... indistinguible.
Queen's Recruit#569.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#570.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: Y sin embargo, aquí estás. Eso me intriga. ¿Qué tienes de especial? ¿Qué fuerza te ha traído hasta aquí?
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#571.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: Pero no importa. Las respuestas llegarán con el tiempo... si te eligen. Veo que tienes una pregunta. Dila.
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: Hm. Una hoja en blanco... poder ver el mundo exterior, con todo su esplendor y sus defectos, presenciar de cerca las semillas profundas de su destrucción inevitable... eso tiene valor.
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#573.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#573.dst: Lo has visto, ¿verdad? Fuerzas que nos superan a todos pugnan por dominar nuestro mundo, sin importarles la destrucción que siembran.
Queen's Recruit#573.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#574.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: Y es un mundo realmente hermoso, ¿no crees? Pensar que podría ser destruido, arrebatado por esa guerra incesante sin sentido ni propósito...
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#575.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#575.dst: Entonces has visto de primera mano los beneficios. La provincia se libra de quienes podrían causar problemas, y el frente de Wynn se refuerza.
Queen's Recruit#575.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#576.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#576.dst: Claro está, muchos rechazarán la llamada. Muchos más se estancarán en sus nuevos papeles. Pero en unos pocos elegidos... hay potencial para mucho, mucho más.
Queen's Recruit#576.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#578.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#578.dst: Eso será todo. Vuelve a tus aposentos por esta noche. Mandaré llamar al otro finalista en breve.
Queen's Recruit#578.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#579.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#579.dst: Vuelve a la habitación W-{~} y habla con Tasim en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#581.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#581.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#582.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#582.dst: ...ya me estaba preocupando un poco. Has estado un buen rato ahí arriba.
Queen's Recruit#582.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#586.dst: Ja. Bueno, ahora me pongo algo nervioso.
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#588.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#588.dst: Voy a... tener que hacer alguna pregunta más.
Queen's Recruit#588.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#590.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#590.dst: Ay, esto es un desastre. Nos han separado, y ahora estamos atrapados aquí.
Queen's Recruit#590.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#591.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#591.dst: Tenemos que idear un plan... ¿habría alguna forma de
Queen's Recruit#591.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#592.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#592.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#594.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#595.dst: No... no te quedes esperándome. Ve a descansar. Estaré... bien, creo.
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#600.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#600.dst: Fue... bien, supongo. Seguramente te dijo... casi lo mismo que a mí.
Queen's Recruit#600.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#603.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#603.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#604.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#604.dst: ¿Entrenamos? Un combate de prueba, antes... antes de mañana. Como antaño.
Queen's Recruit#604.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#605.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#605.dst: Solo prepárate y nos vemos en la arena. ¿Vale?
Queen's Recruit#605.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#606.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#606.dst: Yo... sí. Estoy bien. Solo... ¿entrenamos? Un combate de prueba, antes de... mañana. Por los viejos tiempos.
Queen's Recruit#606.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#607.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#607.dst: Solo... prepárate y nos vemos en la arena. ¿Vale?
Queen's Recruit#607.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#610.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#610.dst: Fue... bien, supongo. Seguramente te dijo... casi lo mismo que a mí.
Queen's Recruit#610.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: Iba a preguntarte si podía pedirte un favor.
Queen's Recruit#613.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#614.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#614.dst: ¿Entrenamos? Un combate de prueba, antes... antes de mañana. Como antaño.
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: Solo prepárate y nos vemos en la arena. ¿Vale?
Queen's Recruit#615.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#616.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#616.dst: Yo... sí. Estoy bien. Solo... ¿entrenamos? Un combate de prueba, antes de... mañana. Por los viejos tiempos.
Queen's Recruit#616.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: Solo... prepárate y nos vemos en la arena. ¿Vale?
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#623.src: He's... what what happened? How do you know? How how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: Él... qué... ¿qué pasó? ¿Cómo lo sabes? ¿Cómo... cómo puedes saberlo?
Queen's Recruit#623.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#631.src: I... Gods. And, you you've been tr-trying to
Queen's Recruit#631.dst: Yo... Dioses. Y tú... has estado in-intentando
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#633.src: I I need to go. I need some space. I'll I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#633.dst: Tengo que irme. Necesito espacio. Voy a la arena. Necesito... necesito...
Queen's Recruit#633.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#634.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not not now. If... if you need me... you'll you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#634.dst: No. No, n-no lo hagas. No hagas eso. Ahora no, ahora... ahora no. Si... si me necesitas... ya... ya sabes dónde estoy.
Queen's Recruit#634.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#635.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#635.dst: Ve a la arena para un combate de entrenamiento contra Tasim.

Queen's Recruit#636.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#636.dst: Prepárate y nos vemos en la arena. ¿Vale?
Queen's Recruit#636.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#637.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: Está... muy tranquilo. Ni un guardia.
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#639.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#639.dst: Ay. No tiene sentido intentar salir de aquí. Solo nos queda llegar hasta el final.
Queen's Recruit#639.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#641.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#641.dst: ¿Tú qué opinas? ¿De lo que dijo ella? Sobre... fuerzas destruyendo el mundo.
Queen's Recruit#641.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: She's right. I've seen it I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: Tiene razón. Yo lo he visto... sé que tú también. Y va... a peor.
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#643.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#643.dst: Pero... los reclutas. Los reclutas. Eso no puedo superarlo. Es tan...
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#645.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#645.dst: Bajemos y luchemos sin más. Los sitios de siempre, ¿no?
Queen's Recruit#645.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#648.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#648.dst: Sin palabras. Luchemos. Solo... solo un entrenamiento. Para... medir fuerzas.
Queen's Recruit#648.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#652.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#652.dst: Supongo que ya sabemos cómo acabará lo de mañana.
Queen's Recruit#652.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: No, no lo niegues. Los dos sabemos que tengo razón.
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#654.src: No- don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#654.dst: No- no lo niegues. Los dos sabemos que es así.
Queen's Recruit#654.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#656.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#656.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#657.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#657.dst: Una elección. No sé qué hacer con ella. Y... me da miedo tomar cualquiera de las dos opciones.
Queen's Recruit#657.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#658.src: I... I need to think it over some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#658.dst: Yo... necesito pensarlo algo más. Y los dos tenemos que descansar.
Queen's Recruit#658.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#659.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#659.dst: ¿Eh? Yo... sí. Creo que sí. Solo tengo muchas cosas en la cabeza.
Queen's Recruit#659.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#660.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: Te lo... cuento por la mañana. Solo tengo muchas cosas en la cabeza.
Queen's Recruit#660.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#661.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#661.dst: Ja. Qué... qué nivel. Uf. Esto lo voy a notar... un buen rato.
Queen's Recruit#661.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#663.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: ¿Por qué ha tenido que acabar así? ¿Por qué... por qué no pudimos ser felices y ya está?
Queen's Recruit#663.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#664.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: Él... él me mandó una carta por aquella misión, ¿sabes? ¿Te lo conté? Por eso volví a Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#664.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#665.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#665.dst: Y resulta que él ya... ya no estaba. Y tú estuviste allí, y yo no.
Queen's Recruit#665.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#667.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#667.dst: Quiero echarte la culpa. Quiero poder enfadarme, odiarte. Pero... no puedo. Simplemente no puedo.
Queen's Recruit#667.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#668.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: Ojalá hubiera estado allí. Ojalá lo hubiera hecho mejor. Quizá habría podido... o quizá habría acabado igual.
Queen's Recruit#668.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#670.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#670.dst: ¡Y ahora estamos los dos aquí, de donde nos desterraron! Pero él... él no. Él ya no está, y... y nosotros seguimos aquí.
Queen's Recruit#670.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#671.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: ...¿qué se supone que hago? ¿Qué se supone que hacemos? Con todo esto.
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#674.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#674.dst: Hice muchas preguntas. No me gustaron todas las respuestas, pero... me dejó una elección.
Queen's Recruit#674.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#676.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#676.dst: No sé qué hacer. Necesito... necesito... necesito pensar.
Queen's Recruit#676.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#677.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#677.dst: Dame algo de espacio, por favor. Nos vemos por la mañana.
Queen's Recruit#677.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#678.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.
Queen's Recruit#678.dst: Vuelve a tu habitación y pasa la noche.

Queen's Recruit#680.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#680.dst: Lee la nota que Tasim te dejó antes de salir.

Queen's Recruit#681.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#681.dst: Ve al despacho de Su Majestad para conocer su decisión.

Queen's Recruit#683.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#683.dst: Ya has fracasado, ¿sabes? No cumpliste sus criterios de selección.

Queen's Recruit#684.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#684.dst: Pero ¿descartarte de plano sería un error? Desde luego tienes poder. Quizá incluso más del que deberías, dadas las circunstancias.

Queen's Recruit#685.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#685.dst: Aun así. Te falta el impulso, la perspectiva. La entrega. La comprensión.

Queen's Recruit#686.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#686.dst: Y, lo más crítico - eres impredecible. Y eso te convierte en un peligro.

Queen's Recruit#687.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#687.dst: ¡Ah! Parece que Su Majestad y yo pensamos igual. Maravilloso.

Queen's Recruit#688.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?

Queen's Recruit#689.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#689.dst: Tantas preguntas sin respuesta. ¿Elegirás soltarlo todo? ¿Descartar las posibilidades?

Queen's Recruit#690.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#690.dst: ¿Y si no? ¿Qué harías por vislumbrar la verdad? ¿Por una oportunidad de recibir respuestas?

Queen's Recruit#691.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#691.dst: Hm. Sea como sea, la elección es tuya. ¡Quizá me sorprendas, después de todo! ¿No sería emocionante?

Queen's Recruit#692.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#692.dst: {u}, por orden de Su Majestad, se le escoltará fuera de Fruma con efecto inmediato.
Queen's Recruit#692.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#693.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#693.dst: Cualquier desacato se considerará una amenaza oficial contra Fruma por parte de la provincia de Wynn. Obedezca y nadie saldrá herido.
Queen's Recruit#693.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#694.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#694.dst: Aquí no tiene ningún poder. Esta elección no es suya. Obedecerá las órdenes o afrontará las consecuencias.
Queen's Recruit#694.speaker: Gendarme Commander
